ambiguities_declared: The EXTRACT[1] and EXTRACT[2] mandatory notice templates contain fill-in-the-blank placeholders (e.g., 'required bin determination date', 'treatment plant name') that are not actual values and could not be extracted as claims without guessing specific dates or names.
The citation node '[71 FR 768, Jan. 5, 2006]' indicates a promulgation/effective date for the section but no explicit compliance deadline claim could be derived from it without further context.

verified_quotes.exact_text: The owner or operator of a community or non-community water system that is required to monitor source water under § 141.701 must notify persons served by the water system that monitoring has not been completed as specified no later than 30 days after the system has failed to collect any 3 months of monitoring as specified in § 141.701(c).

The owner or operator of a community or non-community water system that is required to determine a bin classification under § 141.710, or to determine mean Cryptosporidium level under § 141.712, must notify persons served by the water system that the determination has not been made as required no later than 30 days after the system has failed report the determination as specified in § 141.710(e) or § 141.712(a), respectively.
The notice is not required if the system is complying with a State-approved schedule to address the violation.
The form and manner of the public notice must follow the requirements for a Tier 2 public notice prescribed in § 141.203(c). The public notice must be presented as required in § 141.205(c).
Each special notice must also include a description of what the system is doing to correct the violation and when the system expects to return to compliance or resolve the situation.
